text: Propositional extensionality (propext) follows from univalence: for propositions P and Q,
choices: (P ↔ Q) implies P = Q (a proposition equivalence gives a path)
P and Q are always equal
P = Q iff both are provable
explanation: Propext: if P and Q are propositions and P↔Q, then they are equivalent (P≃Q), so by univalence P=Q. This is the propositional version of univalence.
